brief.summary: Polished, grown-up femininity: almost always a midi dress — a sleeveless column or a belted shirt dress with a full pleated skirt — in black, navy or ivory. Texture (tweed, bouclé, pleats, appliqué) instead of print; one deep accent; pointed pumps or a fine strappy sandal.
signatures: belted shirt dress with a full pleated midi skirt
cardigan over a crisp shirt with a pleated plaid midi skirt
silhouettes: fitted bodice, column or full pleated skirt
